description: Connect your assistant to one SMAT brand, or to all brands of an account you own. Read saved brand context, strategy, insights, publication results and competitor posts; see what needs attention, the weekly schedule and topic ideas; create and edit drafts; work with uploaded media, text-on-image looks and carousels; manage the schedule; and prepare, schedule or publish supported Facebook and Instagram posts. SMAT's AI actions (captions, image ideas, images and image edits, text for images, topic refresh) and new competitor analysis are optional, use SMAT credits by actual usage and need separate confirmation. Available actions depend on your account, scopes and content readiness. A paid SMAT plan is required; a trial counts.

defaultPrompt: Read the connected brand's saved strategy and three recent posts. Do not refresh or change anything.
Create a draft from this text for the connected brand, then read the saved draft back. Do not generate an image or publish.
Show the current preview and explain what would be required to publish it. Do not publish.
